Calculate hourly temperature for a given day

Source: R/leaf_wet.R
dot-diurnal_temp.Rd

Uses doy, location (lat) and TMIN and TMAX to calculate hourly temperatures.

Usage

.diurnal_temp(lat, doy, tmin, tmax)

Arguments

lat

Latitude as provided by wth via seir()

doy

Sequential day of year as provided by wth via seir()

tmin

Minimum temperature as provided by wth via seir()

tmax

Maximum temperature as provided by wth via seir()

dayl

Daylight hours as provided by wth via seir()

Value

A numeric vector of hourly temperature values for the duration of wth data

Author

Robert J. Hijmans with modifications by Adam H. Sparks

Examples

wth <- get_wth(
  lonlat = c(121.25562, 14.6774),
  dates = c("2000-06-30", "2000-12-31")
)

.diurnal_temp(
  lat = wth[, LAT],
  doy = wth[, DOY],
  tmin = wth[, TMIN],
  tmax = wth[, TMAX]
)
#> Error in .diurnal_temp(lat = wth[, LAT], doy = wth[, DOY], tmin = wth[,     TMIN], tmax = wth[, TMAX]): could not find function ".diurnal_temp"
